name: PARALLAX
install: if ! python3 -c 'import ensurepip' >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3-venv; fi && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements-dev.txt

terminals.name: Web
terminals.description: PARALLAX website and API at http://127.0.0.1:8000
